title: Web System Developer | NFC Digital Business Cards
bio: I create NFC digital business cards and custom web systems. One tap of your card on a phone opens your own page with your photo, contact details, and social links. No app needed, and they can save your number instantly.
highlights: Share everything with one tap, no app to install
One-tap "Save Contact" puts you straight into their phone
Your own private link, made only for you
Change your details anytime without reprinting
Works on most modern iPhone and Android phones
Also building websites and systems for your business
